title: Collatz matrix obstructions, synchronization, and basin densities: three papers and Lean artifacts
description:
Three standalone papers with LaTeX sources, PDFs, Lean proof sources, and fresh verification reports: (1) Two-coordinate obstructions for affine interpretations of the Yolcu–Aaronson–Heule Collatz system; (2) An independent second proof of Said Duran’s equal-height Collatz runs theorem; (3) Collatz basin densities and canonical traces from first-passage stabilization.

The matrix and synchronization scope has 137 checked Lean modules and 633 public theorem/lemma declarations. The basin scope currently checks selected steps in 11 modules, including the complete abstract two-scale averaging lemma. The second arithmetic scale of Tao’s first-passage theorem and the downstream Green/cylinder identifications are not yet fully formalized. Priority for the equal-height existence theorem belongs to Omar Javier Said Duran. None of these papers proves the Collatz conjecture.

License scope: Lean code, scripts, and repository documentation outside paper/ use the MIT License. Papers and their LaTeX sources and PDFs use Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0); code excerpts retain MIT. Third-party material retains its original rights. This DOI archives the complete repository release, containing the three individually titled papers.
